f1_hero_desc: A high-octane fusion of Cantonese dim sum craftsmanship and Formula 1 speed. Each bite is engineered for peak performance.
f1_story_1: When the lights go out at the starting grid, the real race begins — in the kitchen. Our master chefs swap their aprons for racing overalls as we fuse the precision of Cantonese dim sum craftsmanship with the high-octane energy of Formula 1.
f1_story_2: Every dim sum is engineered for speed and flavor. Our steamers act as pit boxes, our baskets as chassis, and every dumpling is a perfectly balanced package of taste — just like a race car tuned to perfection.
f1_story_quote: 🏁 一笼两项，飞速品尝 — A steamer basket of speed, a taste of victory.
f1_special_desc_1: Join us for live Grand Prix screenings paired with our exclusive F1 Dim Sum Menu. From qualifying to the checkered flag, every session has its perfect pairing.
f1_special_desc_2: Our chefs work in shifts just like pit crews — ready to serve your dim sum at the perfect moment, every time.
grand_prix_menu_sub: Engineered for speed. Crafted for victory. Served in bamboo steamers that hit like a pit stop.
speed_king_desc: Red Bull-inspired juicy pork and shrimp dumplings with an extra kick of chili oil — for those who race to the front.
